q: After bifurcation, which of the following is major source of irrigation in Andhra Pradesh?
explanation: Wells (groundwater) now irrigate the largest net area in AP – 12.42 lakh ha against 10.08 lakh ha by canals in 2023-24; drip, tanks and ponds are minor.

exam: APPSC Group-II Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I 2017
q: Which district of Andhra Pradesh has maximum number of over exploited Mandals with regard to Ground water?
explanation: Anantapur, the driest district, has had the largest number of over-exploited mandals in AP's groundwater estimations.

notes.text: - **38,862 tanks**; groundwater stage **31.5% (Safe)**; **12 of 679** mandals over-exploited; **Anantapur** district has had the most over-exploited mandals.
